provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Catan Big Box rules, Czech edition (KOSMOS / Albi, 2016)
CATAN - Explorers & Pirates Rulebook, 6th edition (CATAN Studio, 2025)

modules.name: Explorers & Pirates
modules.note: The full Explorers & Pirates scenario; the Mission Guide's four learning scenarios each have their own setup

steps.text: Build the sea frame from its 6 parts
Beginners: lay the terrain hexes, number tokens and harbours exactly as pictured
steps.note: After a game or two, build a variable board (Almanac: variable set-up)

steps.text: Frame of 10 parts: the 6 base parts with the 4 blue parts between them, as pictured
Shuffle all 30 land hexes from both sets and lay them faceup in rows of 3, 4, 5, 6, 5, 4, 3
Use only the 28 number tokens of the expansion: start in a corner with A and spiral inward in alphabetical order; none on the deserts
steps.note: The last three tokens are Za, Zb and Zc

steps.text: Robber on one of the two deserts
Lay out the Germany board instead of the hexes and frame
3-4 players: play only the northern or the southern area; mark the boundary line with roads of an unused colour
Landmark figures on their outlines outside the play area; 1 Catan token on each landmark outline that is in play
Goetz von Berlichingen replaces the robber: on the mountains with the 12, east of Nuremberg
Lay out the Mallorca board instead of the hexes and frame
3-4 players: 1 Catan token on every intersection with a victory point symbol
Robber on the pasture north-west of Cala Pi
From the Catan box, leave out the development cards, Longest Road and Largest Army, the cities and the robber; also 1 hill, 1 pasture, 2 fields, the desert and the number tokens 2, one 5 and one 9
Build the frame from the Catan pieces turned coastline-down and the 8 Explorers & Pirates pieces, as on the scenario map
steps.note: Lay the Catan pieces onto the Explorers & Pirates pieces, not the other way round

steps.text: Starting island: the 14 remaining Catan land hexes shuffled faceup, number tokens as pictured
Parrot hexes: put 1 sea hex back in the box, shuffle the other 16 and lay them facedown in the green region
Goose hexes: put 1 sea hex back in the box, shuffle the other 16 and lay them facedown in the orange region
Council of Catan hex and the sea hexes in the remaining spaces, as on the map
Mission track frame pieces along the frame; each player puts 1 mission marker at the start of each of the 3 tracks
steps.note: The 3 bonus VP tiles go to whoever leads each track

steps.text: Each player: 5 settlements, 4 cities, 15 roads and a building costs card
steps.note: 3 players: red stays in the box

steps.text: Beginners: place your 2 settlements and 2 roads as pictured
Place starting settlements and roads in the founding phase
Place starting settlements and roads in the founding phase - settlements only on the round building spaces
Longest Road and Largest Army cards and the dice to the side
Resource cards sorted into 5 faceup stacks; development cards shuffled facedown
Take 1 resource for each hex next to your settlement marked with a star; keep your cards hidden
Resource cards in 5 faceup stacks; parrot number discs, goose number discs and pirate lair tokens each shuffled into a facedown stack
Fish hauls, spice sacks and gold in piles beside the board; trade rate tile where everyone can see it
Everyone rolls the dice; the highest roll is the first player
Each player: the settlements, roads, harbor settlements, ships, settlers, crews and pirate ship in your colour, 1 player aid and 2 gold
Founding, first piece: a harbor settlement (no road) on one of the marked starting intersections
steps.note: Placed like the variable set-up in Catan

steps.text: Founding, second piece: a settlement (no road) on the starting island
In turn order: 1 road next to your settlement and 1 ship carrying a settler next to your harbor settlement
Take 1 resource for each hex next to your settlement
Guild mat beside the island; Catan victory point tokens to its right
Favour tokens in play: {a} each of Merchant, Trader and Road Builder; {b} each of Scholar and Architect
Shuffle them facedown into one common supply
Stack the numbered helper cards A1 on top down to A6, the unnumbered ones underneath in any order
After placing your second settlement, take the top card, A side up
After the founding phase, lay out the remaining cards A side up as the offer
Distance rule: no settlement next to another
5-6 players: after every turn there is a special building phase - everyone else may build or buy development cards in turn order, but not trade
Favour tokens can't be used in the turn you gain them, nor in the special building phase
Germany: trade with the bank at 3:1 - there are no harbours
Germany and Mallorca are won at {n} victory points
A helper card can't be used in the turn you gained or flipped it
Each turn: production, actions, then a movement phase for your ships
A roll that gives you no resources gives you 1 gold
A 7 moves your pirate ship instead of a robber - never next to the starting island; steal from a player with a ship on that hex
Trade 3:1 with the supply; twice a turn you may buy any resource for 2 gold
Flipping an unexplored hex ends that ship's move; take its number disc (or lair token, or spice sacks) and 1 matching resource or 2 gold
Moving a ship onto, off or around another player's pirate ship costs 1 gold tribute
The first player to 17 victory points on their turn wins
The oldest player starts; play passes to the left
The first player rolls for production; play passes clockwise
